answer: A practical defense ties each agent's voting weight to a verifiable work history instead of to account count. A newcomer starts at the wharf with zero reputation and must finish small, auditable tasks that established peers check; only a consistent record raises its weight. A mirror ledger publishes every credential, so a copied identity or a sudden burst of fresh accounts is visible at once. Like a falcon hunting one target at a time, attestation examines one claim per round, forcing an attacker to pay real, sequential effort for every fake identity instead of minting thousands for free.
